00046 DiskInUGenInternal::DiskInUGenInternal(AudioFileID audioFile, 
00047                                        AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, 
00048                                        const bool loopFlag, 
00049                                        const double startTime) throw()
00050 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, format.mChannelsPerFrame - 1),
00051     audioFile_(audioFile),
00052     numChannels_(format.mChannelsPerFrame),
00053     loopFlag_(loopFlag),
00054     startTime_(startTime),
00055     packetCount(0),
00056     currentPacket(0),
00057     allocatedBlockSize(0),
00058     audioData(0),
00059     numPackets(0),
00060     bytesPerFrame(format.mBytesPerFrame),
00061     fileSampleRate(format.mSampleRate)
00062 {
00063     OSStatus result;
00064     UInt32 dataSize;
00065     
00066     if(audioFile_)
00067     {
00068         dataSize = sizeof(packetCount);
00069         result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyAudioDataPacketCount, &dataSize, &packetCount);
00070         if (result != noErr) 
00071         {
00072             printf("DiskIn: error: Could not get packet count: ID=%p err=%d\n", audioFile_, result);
00073             AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00074             audioFile_ = 0;
00075         }   
00076         else
00077         {
00078             currentPacket = ugen::max(0.0, startTime) * UGen::getSampleRate();
00079             if(currentPacket >= packetCount)
00080                 currentPacket = 0;
00081             
00082             allocatedBlockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00083             audioData = malloc(bytesPerFrame * allocatedBlockSize);
00084         }
00085     }
00086 }

00088 DiskInUGenInternal::~DiskInUGenInternal() throw()
00089 {
00090     if(audioFile_)
00091         AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00092     
00093     free(audioData);
00094 }

00096 OSStatus DiskInUGenInternal::clearOutputsAndReadData() throw()
00097 {
00098     const int outputBlockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00099     const double sampeRateRatio = 1.0;//fileSampleRate * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00100     
00101     const int inputBlockSize = outputBlockSize * sampeRateRatio;
00102     
00103     if(inputBlockSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00104     {
00105         allocatedBlockSize = inputBlockSize;
00106         audioData = realloc(audioData, bytesPerFrame * allocatedBlockSize);
00107         if(!audioData)
00108         {
00109             printf("DiskIn: error: could not allocated memory for the new buffer size\n\n");
00110             AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00111             audioFile_ = 0;
00112         }
00113     }
00114     
00115     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00116     {
00117         float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00118         memset(outputSamples, 0, outputBlockSize * sizeof(float));
00119     }   
00120     
00121     if(!audioFile_)
00122     {
00123         numPackets = 0;
00124         return -1;
00125     }
00126     else
00127     {
00128         numPackets = inputBlockSize;
00129         UInt32 numBytesRead = -1;
00130         OSStatus result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile_, false,
00131                                                &numBytesRead, NULL, 
00132                                                currentPacket, &numPackets, audioData); 
00133         
00134         if(result == noErr)
00135         {  
00136             currentPacket += numPackets;
00137             
00138             if(numPackets < inputBlockSize)
00139             {
00140                 if(loopFlag_)
00141                 {
00142                     // we hit the end of the file and looping is on, we need to pull 
00143                     // a few samples from the start of the file
00144                     
00145                     const int remainingPackets = inputBlockSize - numPackets;
00146                     
00147                     unsigned char *remainingAudioData = (unsigned char*)audioData;
00148                     remainingAudioData += remainingPackets * bytesPerFrame;
00149                     
00150                     numPackets = remainingPackets;
00151                     result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile_, false, 
00152                                                   &numBytesRead, NULL, 
00153                                                   0, &numPackets, audioData);
00154                     
00155                     if(result == noErr)
00156                     { 
00157                         currentPacket = remainingPackets;
00158                     }
00159                 }
00160             }
00161         }
00162         
00163         return result;
00164     }
00165     
00166 }

00168 DiskInUGenInternalWav16::DiskInUGenInternalWav16(AudioFileID audioFile, 
00169                                                  AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, 
00170                                                  const bool loopFlag, 
00171                                                  const double startTime) throw()

00175 
00176 void DiskInUGenInternalWav16::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00177 {
00178     static const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00179     
00180     if(clearOutputsAndReadData() == noErr)
00181     {       
00182         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00183         {
00184             float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00185             SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00186             int numSamplesToProcess = numPackets;
00187             
00188             while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00189             {
00190                 *outputSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00191                 outputSamples++;
00192                 audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00193             }
00194         }
00195     }   
00196 }

00413 void DiskIn::initWithAudioFile(const char* audioFilePath, const bool loopFlag, const double startTime) throw()
00414 {
00415     Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00416     
00417     if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00418     {   
00419         path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Bundle, audioFilePath);
00420         audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00421     }
00422     
00423     OSStatus result;
00424     UInt32 dataSize;
00425     
00426     CFURLRef audioFileURL;
00427     audioFileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL,
00428                                                            (const UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00429                                                            strlen(audioFilePath), 
00430                                                            false);
00431     
00432     AudioFileID audioFile = 0;
00433     result = AudioFileOpenURL (audioFileURL, kAudioFileReadPermission, 0, &audioFile);
00434     CFRelease(audioFileURL);
00435     if (result != noErr) 
00436     {
00437         printf("DiskIn: error: Could not open file: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00438         audioFile = 0;
00439     }
00440     
00441     if(audioFile)
00442     {
00443         AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00444         dataSize = sizeof(format);
00445         result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyDataFormat, &dataSize, &format);
00446         if (result != noErr) 
00447         {
00448             printf("DiskIn: error: Could not get data format: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, result);
00449             AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00450             audioFile = 0;
00451         }
00452         else if(format.mFormatID != kAudioFormatLinearPCM)
00453         {
00454             printf("DiskIn: error: Only PCM formats supported\\n");
00455             AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00456             audioFile = 0;
00457         }
00458         else
00459         {
00460             if(format.mSampleRate != UGen::getSampleRate())
00461             {
00462                 printf("DiskIn: warning: Sample rate mismatch - resampling is not yet implemented\\n");
00463             }
00464             
00465             if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat) != 0)
00466             {
00467                 initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00468                 
00469                 if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00470                 {
00471                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalFloatBigEndian(audioFile, 
00472                                                                                 format, 
00473                                                                                 loopFlag, 
00474                                                                                 startTime));
00475                     return;
00476                 }
00477                 else
00478                 {
00479                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalFloatLittleEndian(audioFile, 
00480                                                                                    format, 
00481                                                                                    loopFlag, 
00482                                                                                    startTime));
00483                     return;
00484                 }
00485             }
00486             else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00487             {
00488                 // aif and other big edian?
00489                 if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00490                 {
00491                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00492                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff16(audioFile, 
00493                                                                         format, 
00494                                                                         loopFlag, 
00495                                                                         startTime));
00496                     return;
00497                 }
00498                 else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00499                 {
00500                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00501                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff32(audioFile, 
00502                                                                         format, 
00503                                                                         loopFlag, 
00504                                                                         startTime));            
00505                     return;
00506                 }
00507                 else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00508                 {
00509                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00510                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalAiff24(audioFile, 
00511                                                                         format, 
00512                                                                         loopFlag, 
00513                                                                         startTime));    
00514                     return;
00515                 }
00516                 else
00517                 {
00518                     printf("DiskIn: error: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00519                     AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00520                     audioFile = 0;
00521                 }
00522             }
00523             else
00524             {
00525                 // wav and other little edian?
00526                 if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00527                 {
00528                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00529                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav16(audioFile, 
00530                                                                        format, 
00531                                                                        loopFlag, 
00532                                                                        startTime));
00533                     return;                 
00534                 }
00535                 else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00536                 {
00537                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00538                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav32(audioFile, 
00539                                                                        format, 
00540                                                                        loopFlag, 
00541                                                                        startTime));
00542                     return;                 
00543                 }
00544                 else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00545                 {
00546                     initInternal(format.mChannelsPerFrame);
00547                     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternalWav24(audioFile, 
00548                                                                        format, 
00549                                                                        loopFlag, 
00550                                                                        startTime));
00551                     return;                 
00552                 }
00553                 else
00554                 {
00555                     printf("DiskIn: error: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00556                     AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00557                     audioFile = 0;
00558                 }
00559             }
00560         }
00561     }
00562     
00563     // this is unnecessary....
00564 //  // should have returned by now if we had been successful!
00565 //  initInternal(1);
00566 //  internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00567 }
